title: Vanilla Sauce (Crème Anglaise)
source: America's Test Kitchen (Cook's Illustrated), vanilla extract version

items.body: Warm the milk in the saucepan over medium heat until steaming, ≈3 min.
Whisk the yolks, sugar and salt in a small bowl until pale yellow, ≈1 min. Whisking constantly, slowly pour in ≈3 tbsp of the hot milk.

Pour the yolk mixture back into the pan with the milk. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly along the bottom and sides, until it thickens slightly, coats the spoon in a thin film and reads 175–180 °F, ≈3–5 min.
Strain at once into a clean bowl. Stir in the vanilla.
Drizzle warm, or press plastic wrap onto the surface and refrigerate until cold. Keeps 2 days.

nutritionSource: USDA FoodData Central: SR Legacy (whole milk, egg yolks, sugar, vanilla extract). Pinch of salt not counted.
notes: A 40% batch of ATK’s recipe (5 yolks, 1½ cups milk, ¼ cup sugar makes ≈2 cups). Keep the heat low and keep stirring. Too hot and the yolks curdle; the strainer catches small bits.
Vanilla bean version (ATK’s original): steep the seeds and pod of ¼ bean in the hot milk, covered, 20 min. Reheat until steaming, then go on. Skip the extract.
Made for French toast on the Braided Brioche. Also good on the Instant Pot Cheesecake or fruit.
